rationale: The only candidate d0a0770808c7 is a 'refactor lpm plugin mechanism' that replaces @packages() with @package(name=...) as part of an API redesign, not a defect repair.
The blamed type-annotation lines were deleted by c86a9a318e4f, a refactor that switches to Arroyo's RunTaskInThreads and removes unused dispatch code, not a bug fix.
The candidate 052145fabd49 only fixes docstring grammar ('return' -> 'returns') across many methods; the new get_resolution_info method itself was never repaired.
The fix drops the obsolete --force flag from the suggested self-upgrade command, but --force was already in these messages before; this change only inserted the 'setup' subcommand.

This change is a pure customer->region rename; the later commit b6d87b8144f2 changes the decorating script's classification logic (all-silo special cases, no silo_limit filter), which is pre-existing behaviour, not something the rename introduced.

The change calls subprocess.call(['command','-v','srun']), but 'command' is a shell builtin and not an executable, so detection fails and can raise an uncaught PermissionError on non-SLURM machines; the fix switches to shutil.which('srun').
The candidate 13458dc72218 centralizes exception handling and only rewrites api.smile_model/api.smile_name as coordinator.api.*, a refactor that keeps the same values.
The candidate e58531f118a0 adds a get_mqtt_data helper and replaces hass.data[DATA_MQTT].client with get_mqtt_data(hass).client, a refactor with the same behaviour.

The later commit changes movflags from 'frag_keyframe' (added here) to 'frag_keyframe+empty_moov', but its message ('Use empty_moov in stream recorder') does not say whether this repairs broken recordings or is a format improvement.

None of the candidates repairs the duplicate-segment check: e4b34ce84ab4 swaps capture_message for capture_exception and adds tags to improve diagnostics (its real fix, the threaded configure_scope, is in other code), 6d5b1f3fa37d is a separately planned IntegrityError feature that only touches matching create() lines, and the last two are metrics and code moves.

Three months later cd2756da2345 stops pigeond from running without a ublox and removes the UbloxAvailable write, which may fix pigeond carrying on after a failed init or may be a redesign of where detection happens; 76f9a1487c2b only moves the lines during a test refactor.
